verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ ጥበበ፡ ዚአየ፡ ነጽር፡ ወንባበ፡ ዚአየ፡ ያጽምእ፡ ዕዝንከ፡ ከመ፡ ትዕቀብከ፡ በሕሊና፡ ሠናይት።
verses.translation: My son, attend to my wisdom, and apply thine ear to my words;

translations.lxx: My son, attend to my wisdom, and apply thine ear to my words;
translations.kjv: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
translations.ron: Fiul meu, ia aminte la înţelepciunea mea şi la sfatul meu cel bun pleacă urechea ta,
translations.grk: Υἱὲ, ἐμῇ σοφίᾳ πρόσεχε, ἐμοῖς δὲ λόγοις παράβαλλε σὸν οὖς,

verses.geez: ወአእምር፡ እምከናፍርየ፡ ዘእኤዝዘከ።
verses.translation: that thou mayest keep good understanding, and the discretion of my lips gives thee a charge. Give no heed to a worthless woman;

translations.lxx: that thou mayest keep good understanding, and the discretion of my lips gives thee a charge. Give no heed to a worthless woman;
translations.kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
translations.ron: Ca să-ţi poţi păstra judecata şi ca buzele tale să păzească ştiinţa.
translations.grk: ἵνα φυλάξῃς ἔννοιαν ἀγαθήν· αἴσθησις δὲ ἐμῶν χειλέων ἐντέλλεταί σοι·

verses.geez: ኢትነፅር፡ ብእሲተ፡ እኪተ፡ እስመ፡ መዓር፡ ይውኅዝ፡ እምከናፍረ፡ ብእሲት፡ ዘማ፡ እንተ፡ ለጊዜሁ፡ ያመዓርዕሮ፡ ለጒርዔከ።
verses.translation: for honey drops from the lips of a harlot, who for a season pleases thy palate:

translations.lxx: for honey drops from the lips of a harlot, who for a season pleases thy palate:
translations.kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
translations.ron: Nu te uita la femeia linguşitoare, căci buzele celei străine picură miere şi cerul gurii sale e mai alunecător decât untdelemnul,
translations.grk: Μὴ πρόσεχε φαύλῃ γυναικί. Μέλι γὰρ ἀποστάζει ἀπὸ χειλέων γυναικὸς πόρνης, ἣ πρὸς καιρὸν λιπαίνει σὸν φάρυγγα,

verses.geez: ወእምድኅሬሁሰ፡ ዘይመርር፡ እምሐሞት፡ ትረክብ፡ ወስሑል፡ ፈድፋደ፡ እመጥባሕት፡ ዘክልኤ፡ አፉሁ።
verses.translation: but afterwards thou wilt find her more bitter than gall, and sharper than a two-edged sword.

translations.lxx: but afterwards thou wilt find her more bitter than gall, and sharper than a two-edged sword.
translations.kjv: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
translations.ron: Dar la sfârşit ea este mai amară decât pelinul, mai tăioasă decât o sabie cu două ascuţişuri.
translations.grk: ὕστερον μέντοι πικρότερον χολῆς εὑρήσεις, καὶ ἠκονημένον μᾶλλον μαχαίρας διστόμου.

verses.geez: ወኀበ፡ ዕበድ፡ እገሪሃ፡ ያወርዱ፡ ወሑረታ፡ ያበውእ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ ወሲኦል።
verses.translation: For the feet of folly lead those who deal with her down to the grave with death; and her steps are not established.

translations.lxx: For the feet of folly lead those who deal with her down to the grave with death; and her steps are not established.
translations.kjv: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
translations.ron: Picioarele ei coboară către moarte; paşii ei duc de-a dreptul în împărăţia morţii.
translations.grk: Τῆς γὰρ ἀφροσύνης οἱ πόδες κατάγουσι τοὺς χρωμένους αὐτῇ μετὰ θανάτου εἰς τὸν ᾅδην, τὰ δὲ ἴχνη αὐτῆς οὐκ ἐρείδεται.

verses.geez: ወአሠራ፡ ኢይትሐወስ፡ እመካነ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ወውስተ፡ ፍናወ፡ ሕይወት፡ ኢይቀርብ፡ ወእቡስ፡ መንኰራኵራ፡ ወአኮ፡ ዘይትዐወቅ።
verses.translation: For she goes not upon the paths of life; but her ways are slippery, and not easily known.

translations.lxx: For she goes not upon the paths of life; but her ways are slippery, and not easily known.
translations.kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
translations.ron: Ea nu ia seama la calea vieţii, paşii ei merg în neştire, nici ea nu ştie unde.
translations.grk: Ὁδοὺς γὰρ ζωῆς οὐκ ἐπέρχεται, σφαλεραὶ δὲ αἱ τροχιαὶ αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ εὔγνωστοι.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ወልድየ፡ ስምዐኒ፡ ወምኑነ፡ ኢትረሲ፡ ንባበ፡ ዚአየ።
verses.translation: Now then, my son, hear me, and make not my words of none effect.

translations.lxx: Now then, my son, hear me, and make not my words of none effect.
translations.kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
translations.ron: Și acum, fiul meu, ascultă-mă și nu te îndepărta de la cuvintele gurii mele.
translations.grk: Νῦν οὖν υἱὲ ἄκουέ μου, καὶ μὴ ἀκύρους ποιήσεις ἐμοὺς λόγους.

verses.geez: ርኁቀ፡ ረሲ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ፍኖተከ፡ ወኢትቅረብ፡ ኀበ፡ ኆኅተ፡ ቤታ።
verses.translation: Remove thy way far from her; draw not near to the doors of her house:

translations.lxx: Remove thy way far from her; draw not near to the doors of her house:
translations.kjv: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
translations.ron: Fereşte-ţi calea ta de ea şi nu te apropia de uşa casei ei,
translations.grk: Μακρὰν ποίησον ἀπʼ αὐτῆς σὴν ὁδόν· μὴ ἐγγίσῃς πρὸς θύραις οἴκων αὐτῆς,

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ኢትወስክ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ሕይወተከ፡ መንብረተከ፡ ለእለ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ምሕረት።
verses.translation: lest thou give away thy life to others, and thy substance to the merciless:

translations.lxx: lest thou give away thy life to others, and thy substance to the merciless:
translations.kjv: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
translations.ron: Ca să nu dai vârtutea ta altora şi anii tăi unuia fără de milă;
translations.grk: ἵνα μὴ πρόῃ ἄλλοις ζωήν σου, καὶ σὸν βίον ἀνελεήμοσιν·

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ኢይጽገቡ፡ ነኪራን፡ ኃይለከ፡ ወፃማ፡ ዚአከ፡ ቤተ፡ ባዕድ፡ ኢይባእ።
verses.translation: lest strangers be filled with thy strength, and thy labours come into the houses of strangers;

translations.lxx: lest strangers be filled with thy strength, and thy labours come into the houses of strangers;
translations.kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
translations.ron: Ca străinii să nu se îndestuleze de strădania ta şi ostenelile tale să nu treacă în casa altuia;
translations.grk: Ἵνα μὴ πλησθῶσιν ἀλλότριοι σῆς ἰσχύος, οἱ δὲ σοὶ πόνοι εἰς οἴκους ἀλλοτρίων ἔλθεσι·

verses.geez: ወትኔስሕ፡ ድኅረ፡ አመ፡ ደክመ፡ ሥጋ፡ ነፍስከ።
verses.translation: and thou repent at last, when the flesh of thy body is consumed,

translations.lxx: and thou repent at last, when the flesh of thy body is consumed,
translations.kjv: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
translations.ron: Ca să nu suspini la sfârşit, când trupul tău şi carnea ta vor fi fără de vlagă,
translations.grk: Καὶ μεταμεληθήσῃ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων, ἡνίκα ἂν κατατριβῶσι σάρκες σώματός σου,

verses.geez: ወትብል፡ እፎ፡ ጸላእኩ፡ ትምህርተ፡ እምንእስየ፡ ወእምተግሣፅ፡ ተግኅሠ፡ ዕዝንየ።
verses.translation: and thou shalt say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart avoided reproofs!

translations.lxx: and thou shalt say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart avoided reproofs!
translations.kjv: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
translations.ron: Şi să zici: "Pentru ce am urât povaţa şi de ce inima mea a urgisit certarea?
translations.grk: καὶ ἐρεῖς, πῶς ἐμίσησα παιδείαν, καὶ ἐλέγχους ἐξέκλινεν ἡ καρδία μου;

verses.geez: ወኢሰማዕኩ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘይሜህሩኒ፡ ወይጌሥፁኒ፡ ወኢያፅማእኩ፡ በእዝንየ።
verses.translation: I heard not the voice of him that instructed me, and taught me, neither did I apply mine ear.

translations.lxx: I heard not the voice of him that instructed me, and taught me, neither did I apply mine ear.
translations.kjv: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
translations.ron: De ce nu am ascultat de îndemnul dascălilor mei şi spre cei ce mă învăţau n-am plecat urechea mea?
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἤκουον φωνὴν παιδεύοντός με καὶ διδάσκοντός με, οὐδὲ παρέβαλλον τὸ οὖς μου.

verses.geez: ዘእንበለ፡ ንስቲት፡ ኮንኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

translations.lxx: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
translations.kjv: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
translations.ron: Puţin a trebuit să nu mă nenorocesc, în plină adunare şi în mijlocul obştei".
translations.grk: Παρʼ ὀλίγον ἐγενόμην ἐν παντὶ κακῷ, ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας καὶ συναγωγῆς.

verses.geez: ማእከለ፡ ማኅበር፡ ወእንግልጋ፡ ስተይ፡ ማየ፡ እምቀሱትከ፡ ወእምነቅዐ፡ ዐዘቅትከ፡ ወየኀዛ፡ ማያት፡ እምዐዘቅትከ፡ ወውስተ፡ መራኅብቲከ፡ ይሑራ፡ ማያቲከ።
verses.translation: Drink waters out of thine own vessels, and out of thine own springing wells.

translations.lxx: Drink waters out of thine own vessels, and out of thine own springing wells.
translations.kjv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
translations.ron: Bea apă din puţul tău şi din pârâiaşele care curg din izvorul tău.
translations.grk: Πίνε ὕδατα ἀπὸ σῶν ἀγγείων, καὶ ἀπὸ σῶν φρεάτων πηγῆς.

verses.geez: ወትኩን፡ ለከ፡ ለባሕቲትከ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ነኪር፡ ዘይነሥአከ፡ ወዓዘቅት፡ ማይከ፡ ትኩን፡ ለከ።
verses.translation: Let not waters out of thy fountain be spilt by thee, but let thy waters go into thy streets.

translations.lxx: Let not waters out of thy fountain be spilt by thee, but let thy waters go into thy streets.
translations.kjv: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
translations.ron: Să nu se risipească izvoarele tale pe uliţă, nici pâraiele tale prin pieţe.
translations.grk: Μὴ ὑπερεκχείσθω σοι ὕδατα ἐκ τῆς σῆς πηγῆς, εἰς δὲ σὰς πλατείας διαπορευέσθω τὰ σὰ ὕδατα.

verses.geez: ወተፈሣሕ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ንእስከ።
verses.translation: Let them be only thine own, and let no stranger partake with thee.

translations.lxx: Let them be only thine own, and let no stranger partake with thee.
translations.kjv: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
translations.ron: Să fie numai pentru tine singur, iar nu pentru străinii care sînt cu tine!
translations.grk: Ἔστω σοι μόνῳ ὑπάρχοντα, καὶ μηδεὶς ἀλλότριος μετασχέτω σοι.

verses.geez: በፍቅረ፡ ኃየል፡ ወዕዋል፡ ተፋቀር፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲትከ።
verses.translation: Let thy fountain of water be truly thine own; and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

translations.lxx: Let thy fountain of water be truly thine own; and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
translations.kjv: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
translations.ron: Binecuvântat să fie izvorul tău şi să te mângâi cu femeia ta din tinereţe.
translations.grk: Ἡ πηγή σου τοῦ ὕδατος ἔστω σοι ἰδία, καὶ συνευφραίνου μετὰ γυναικὸς τῆς ἐκ νεότητός σου.

verses.geez: ሞገሰ፡ ፍቅራ፡ ያረውየከ፡ እንቲአከ፡ ትኩንከ፡ ለከ፡ ወተሀሉ፡ ምስሌከ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ።
verses.translation: Let thy loving hart and thy graceful colt company with thee, and let her be considered thine own, and be with thee at all times; for ravished with her love thou shalt be greatly increased.

translations.lxx: Let thy loving hart and thy graceful colt company with thee, and let her be considered thine own, and be with thee at all times; for ravished with her love thou shalt be greatly increased.
translations.kjv: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
translations.ron: Cerboaică preaiubită şi gazelă plină de farmec să-ţi fie ea; dragostea de ea să te îmbete totdeauna şi iubirea ei să te desfăteze.
translations.grk: Ἔλαφος φιλίας καὶ πῶλος σῶν χαρίτων ὁμιλείτω σοι, ἡ δὲ ἰδία ἡγείσθω σου καὶ συνέστω σοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ· ἐν γὰρ τῇ ταύτης φιλίᾳ συμπεριφερόμενος, πολλοστὸς ἔσῃ.

verses.geez: በዛቲ፡ ፍቅር፡ እንዘ፡ ትትፋቀር፡ ብዙኀ፡ ትከውን፡ ወኵለንታከ፡ ኢየሀሉ፡ ኀበ፡ ነኪርት።
verses.translation: Be not intimate with a strange woman, neither fold thyself in the arms of a woman not thine own.

translations.lxx: Be not intimate with a strange woman, neither fold thyself in the arms of a woman not thine own.
translations.kjv: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
translations.ron: Pentru ce, fiul meu, să te momească femeie străină şi tu să îmbrăţişezi sânul unei necunoscute?
translations.grk: Μὴ πολὺς ἴσθι πρὸς ἀλλοτρίαν, μηδὲ συνέχου ἀγκάλαις τῆς μὴ ἰδίας.

verses.geez: ወኢታውትር፡ እዴከ፡ ኀበ፡ እንተ፡ ኢኮነት፡ እንቲአከ።
verses.translation: For the ways of a man are before the eyes of God, and he looks on all his paths.

translations.lxx: For the ways of a man are before the eyes of God, and he looks on all his paths.
translations.kjv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
translations.ron: Căci cărările omului sunt înaintea Domnului şi El ia seama la toate căile lui.
translations.grk: Ἐνώπιον γάρ εἰσι τῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὀφθαλμῶν ὁδοὶ ἀνδρὸς, εἰς δὲ πάσας τὰς τροχιὰς αὐτοῦ σκοπεύει.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቅድመ፡ አዕይንተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱ፡ ፍናወ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ መንኰራኵሪሁ፡ ያስተሐይጽ።
verses.translation: Iniquities ensnare a man, and every one is bound in the chains of his own sins.

translations.lxx: Iniquities ensnare a man, and every one is bound in the chains of his own sins.
translations.kjv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
translations.ron: Cel fără de lege este prins în laţurile fărădelegilor lui şi de funiile păcatelor lui este înfăşurat.
translations.grk: Παρανομίαι ἄνδρα ἀγρεύουσι, σειραῖς δὲ τῶν ἑαυτοῦ ἁμαρτιῶν ἕκαστος σφίγγεται.

verses.geez: ኃጢአት፡ ያሤግር፡ ብእሴ፡ ወበኀብለ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ኵሉ፡ ይትሐሰል።
verses.translation: Such a man dies with the uninstructed; and he is cast forth from the abundance of his own substance, and has perished through folly.

translations.lxx: Such a man dies with the uninstructed; and he is cast forth from the abundance of his own substance, and has perished through folly.
translations.kjv: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
translations.ron: El va muri în păcatele lui şi de mulţimea nebuniei lui va pieri.
translations.grk: Οὗτος τελευτᾷ μετὰ ἀπαιδεύτων, ἐκ δὲ πλήθους τῆς ἑαυτοῦ βιότητος ἐξεῤῥίφη, καὶ ἀπώλετο διʼ ἀφροσύνην.

verses.geez: ዝንቱ፡ ይመውት፡ ምስለ፡ ዓብዳን፡ ወእምብዝኀ፡ ዕበዱ፡ ተገድፈ፡ ሕይወቱ፡ ወተኀጒለ፡ ብእንተ፡ ዕበዱ።
